devNotes.issueTitle: Day 7: A room of one's own
devNotes.content: ### Present sir I hate to share stuff which is not need for the other person. And the reason that I am writing this is because I want a indie platform to talk about design in general. To give an opinion an to read some ones about a design. Generally I don’t have an opinion about stuff that don’t bother me. but for Design I feel creativity is not an output of discipline but I think learning and consumption the content is and has to be constantly fed upon. people thing design is about creativity but I thing is coping good stuff and restructure it in your own way. which explain my process of design. I started as i want to create a unique design which is fresh but While discovering the design world I found out that nothing has a fixed process the hole concept of design is very flexible as design is subjective. This space is collection of my progress showcasing the evolution of my design and the process behind it. also the space is a random mess because If every thing is in a structure for me it is annoying after some time.
